how to make tea: Tea Recipe: 1) Boil water, 2) Add tea leaves/powder, 3) Add sugar, 4) Add milk, 5) Boil for 2-3 minutes, 6) Strain and serve hot.
tea recipe: Simple Tea: Boil 1 cup water, add 1 tsp tea leaves, 2 tsp sugar, boil 2 min, add 1/4 cup milk, boil 1 min, strain and enjoy!
how to make coffee: Coffee Recipe: 1) Boil milk, 2) Add coffee powder and sugar, 3) Mix well, 4) Serve hot. For filter coffee: use decoction with milk and sugar.
coffee recipe: Instant Coffee: Heat 1 cup milk/water, add 1-2 tsp coffee powder, 2 tsp sugar, mix well. Serve hot or cold as preferred.
how to make lemon juice: Lemon Juice: 1) Squeeze lemon, 2) Add water, 3) Add sugar/salt, 4) Mix well, 5) Add ice, 6) Serve chilled. Perfect for summer!
lemon juice recipe: Fresh Lemon Juice: Mix juice of 1 lemon, 1 glass water, 2 tbsp sugar/honey, pinch of salt. Add mint leaves for extra freshness.
how to make sweets: Basic Sweet: Mix milk/khoya with sugar, cook until thick, add flavorings, shape and garnish. Different sweets have specific recipes.
simple sweet recipe: Quick Rava Kesari: Roast 1 cup rava, add 2 cups water+sugar, cook until thick, add ghee and cardamom. Simple and delicious!
how to cook rice: Perfect Rice: 1) Wash rice, 2) Soak 30 min, 3) Boil water (1:2 rice:water ratio), 4) Add rice, 5) Cook 15-20 min, 6) Drain water if needed.
rice cooking: Rice Recipe: For 1 cup rice, use 2 cups water. Boil water, add rice, simmer covered for 15 min. Fluff with fork before serving.
how to make biryani: Biryani Steps: 1) Marinate meat, 2) Prepare rice, 3) Layer rice and meat, 4) Add spices, 5) Dum cook 20-30 min. Serve with raita.
biryani recipe: Chicken Biryani: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices. Cook rice 70%. Layer rice and chicken. Dum cook 20 min. Garnish with fried onions.
how to make chicken gravy: Chicken Gravy: 1) Sauté onions, 2) Add tomatoes and spices, 3) Cook until oil separates, 4) Add chicken, 5) Cook until tender, 6) Garnish.
chicken gravy recipe: Butter Chicken Style: Marinate chicken, grill. Make gravy with onions, tomatoes, butter, cream and spices. Add chicken and simmer.
how to make fish fry: Fish Fry: 1) Marinate fish with spices, 2) Coat with flour/rava, 3) Shallow fry in oil, 4) Flip until golden brown, 5) Serve hot with lemon.
fish fry recipe: Crispy Fish Fry: Marinate fish pieces with chili, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste. Coat with semolina. Shallow fry 3-4 min each side.
